evidence: app/src/app.js:1 — imports only Hono core (new Hono, c.html), stable since v3/v4
app/src/index.js:1 — serve() from @hono/node-server, API unchanged from v1
app/src/views/layout.js:1 — hono/html tagged template, stable helper
app/package.json:6-8 — htmx.org 2.0.11 (stable since Nov 2024), hono ^4.13.14 current stable line
app/src/app.js:307 — plain c.text for 500s; no streaming/SSE/WS helpers used
reach.rationale: No experimental, preview, beta, RC or canary APIs anywhere. The only recent artifact is the @hono/node-server v2 major (v2.0.0 released 2026-04-21), and the app uses only the v1-identical API surface, so nothing rests on new code.

evidence: app/src/app.js:2 — serveStatic is the single adaptor-specific import, confined to static asset routes
app/src/index.js:1-9 — server bootstrap is the only place touching the adaptor
app/src/views/*.js — all views use only hono/html plus local helpers
containment.rationale: Nothing experimental to contain; the adaptor usage is already confined to two files, so a future adaptor change would be a two-line edit.

evidence: app/src/app.js:75,177 — htmx partial swaps via HX-Request header are the only 'enhancement' mechanism, and they degrade to full page renders
app/scripts/build.mjs:10 — htmx is vendored at build time rather than pulled from a CDN
app/src/api.js:8-18 — data layer uses plain fetch + in-memory promise cache, no speculative APIs
justification.rationale: No experimental APIs are used, so there is nothing gratuitous; every chosen API is the boring, documented-stable option for its job.

summary: The app is built exclusively on long-stable, documented APIs: Hono 4 core, hono/html, the @hono/node-server serve/serveStatic pair, Node built-ins, and htmx 2 attributes/events. The sole recent item is the @hono/node-server v2 major (2026-04-21), whose release notes confirm the public API is unchanged and the app indeed uses only v1-shaped calls. Zero experimental surface means zero upgrade-breakage risk, though also no early adoption of where the framework is heading.

experimentalApis.source: https://github.com/honojs/node-server/releases/tag/v2.0.0 — 'the public API stays the same'; listed for transparency only, API used predates v1.19
